title: Uncollapsed Panel Styling Bug
description: ui: There is a bug when clicking on e.g. the left window panel then when it uncollapses the toggle is cut and has wrong styling.
summary: Fix 1px vertical gap at top/bottom of panel tabs in Ribbon rows. Changed flex items-center to items-stretch on panelTabBarBaseClass so the button elements are forced by the layout engine to span the exact 27px height of the row instead of resolving h-full against possibly-fractional container sizes.
